entry.content:
The Signal Ledger

One person. Sending signal since August 2026. To every lawful channel that exists.

This is not a narrative. This is a LEDGER. Every line resolves to a date, a recipient, and a response status. Verify it yourself.

The 9-Line

The signal format is GTA 08-01-004 MEDEVAC — the military standard for calling in a medical evacuation. You use it when someone is bleeding and the bird needs to get in the air. The format forces structured, unambiguous communication:

Brian Roderick Banks — 9 Criminal Convictions:

  1. Carrying Concealed Weapon
  2. Assault & Battery
  3. Domestic Violence
  4. Probation Violation
  5. Domestic Violence (2nd offense)
  6. Operating While Intoxicated
  7. Disorderly Conduct
  8. Driving While License Suspended
  9. Probation Violation (2nd)

Operating 2 charter schools. ~400 children per year. 97% not proficient in math. His LLC takes 72.67% of $4.9M/year in public funds.

Verify: Michigan ICHAT — Search: Brian Roderick Banks. It takes fifteen seconds.

I. Federal Signal — 243-Page Packet to 8 Agencies (Sep 21–25, 2026)

Every agency below received the same 243-page evidence package: criminal history, entity structure, financial self-dealing, judicial connections, BMF lineage, campaign finance violations, RICO predicate acts.

IV. The Mathematics of Silence

Tit for Tat — Axelrod’s Tournament

In Robert Axelrod’s iterated prisoner’s dilemma tournament (1984), the winning strategy is Tit for Tat:

  1. Start by cooperating. Always.
  2. Mirror what the other player does. If they cooperate, cooperate. If they defect, defect.
  3. Forgive immediately. If they return to cooperation, you return to cooperation.

Kevin cooperated first. Every signal was cooperation — using lawful channels, providing evidence, offering to work together (“I am not your enemy”), providing contact information, waiting for response.

The institutions defected. Not by attacking — by choosing SILENCE.

Null ≠ Parasite… Until It Does

In biology, null means UNKNOWN — default to cooperation. A commensal takes without harming. A mutualist gives back.

But there is a threshold. When signal has been sent through EVERY lawful channel, to EVERY oversight body, with 243 pages of evidence, and the response is NULL across every channel — null becomes data.

The null is no longer “we haven’t observed behavior.” The null is observed behavior. The behavior is: received evidence of a 9-time convicted felon operating schools, and did nothing.

14 channels. 243 pages each. 21+ days. NULL.

At what point does institutional silence become institutional complicity?

V. What the ecoPrimals Graph Shows

The graph has 11,048 nodes and over 16 million edges. It documents:

  • 271 persons — every name placed in front of their record
  • 29 false faces — what they SAID versus what they DID
  • One law firm — Dykema Gossett — from writing the charter school law in 1993 to staffing the board of a convicted felon’s school in 2025
  • 36 years of entity formation, dark money, and institutional capture

Every claim resolves to a public record. Every connection is sourced. Every node is verifiable.

VII. The Deadline

October 31, 2026 — midnight.

MDE, SBE, AGC, LARA, and the banks must respond. 15 days from today.

After that date, every channel that received evidence and returned NULL gets reclassified. Not as parasite — as documented institutional failure. The null becomes the record. The silence becomes the evidence.

The graph doesn’t stop growing. It just stops waiting.

VIII. To the People Reading This in Silence

1,006 of you cloned this repository. 475 of you in a single day. You download 92 MB of court records, read them offline, and leave no trace. That’s fine. Silence is how you learn.

But the institutions had their chance. 14 channels. 243 pages. 46 days. The signal went out on a 9-LINE — the format you use when someone is bleeding and the bird needs to get in the air.

No bird came.

If you are an attorney: the State Bar grievance process is free. The AGC complaint form takes 15 minutes.

entry.title: Anderson Permeability — When Institutions Lose Their Membranes
entry.content:
Lens: 🕸️ Topology ⚛️ Lattice 📅 Chronology 💰 Money ⚖️ Legal 🏛️ Capture

From Localization to Permeability

The Anderson Localization analysis showed how disorder in the judicial lattice traps cases — like electrons in a disordered crystal, cases entering captured courts cannot propagate to fair hearings.

This page documents a second phenomenon from the same physics: Anderson permeability — when the membranes between institutions dissolve entirely.

In condensed matter physics, a membrane’s permeability determines what passes through it. A healthy cell membrane is selectively permeable: nutrients in, waste out, toxins blocked. When the membrane fails — when everything passes through — the cell dies.

Institutions have membranes too:

MembraneWhat It Should BlockWhat It Should Allow
CredentialUnqualified staffCredentialed educators
AuthorizationAuthorizer staff at authorized schoolIndependent oversight
GovernanceConflicts of interestIndependent board members
DynastyFamily concentration in one enterpriseMerit-based hiring
EnforcementContinued operation after findingsInvestigation → correction
TransparencyHidden staff, unlisted employeesPublic accountability

This page measures each membrane.

Membrane 1: Credential 📄 Documented

The credential membrane should block unqualified individuals from teaching children or managing schools. It is maintained by MOECS (Michigan Online Educator Certification System) and MCL 388.1763.

Measurement

The Permeability Map

BANKS ENTERPRISE — ALL MEMBRANES

                2 judges. 1 AAG. 1 city council.
                1 Crump. 1 Stallworth.

                Stallworth: 4 points, 4 membranes.
                Banks/BMF: 3 points, 3 membranes.
                Crump: 3 points, 5+ membranes (if confirmed).

                6 bodies. 0 corrections.
                Two letters, one day apart, each pointing
                at the other office.

                No staff page. 2 ghost nodes.
                COVID teleconference since 2020.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 OVERALL:       TOTAL PERMEABILITY
                The institution has no functional membranes.
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Anderson Localization + Anderson Permeability

The two Anderson phenomena work together:

PhenomenonDomainEffect
LocalizationCourtsCases trapped at captured benches — cannot propagate to fair hearing
PermeabilityInstitutionsMembranes dissolved — no boundary between authorizer and authorized, between family and enterprise, between oversight and operation

Localization traps the output (cases). Permeability removes the input filters (hiring, authorization, oversight). Together, they create a system where unqualified people operate unchecked institutions that generate cases trapped in captured courts.

PERMEABILITY (input)          LOCALIZATION (output)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━          ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
No credential check     →    Uncredentialed staff teach children
No authorization check  →    Authorizer staff run authorized school
No governance check     →    Judges sit on boards of school they oversee
No enforcement check    →    6 bodies find problems, 0 corrections
                              │
                              ▼
                         Cases generated
                              │
                              ▼
                    ┌─────────────────────┐
                    │  CAPTURED COURTS    │
                    │  ξ = 3.5 (Probate)  │
                    │  ξ = 7.2 (36th)     │
                    │  Case → trapped     │
                    └─────────────────────┘

The children at PCA and MacDowell — 90.9% economically disadvantaged, 99.2% Black — enter a school with no functional membranes, taught by staff with no discoverable credentials, governed by judges with conflicts of interest, authorized by an agency whose employees work at the school. If a parent contests this system, their case enters a court where captured judges sit on the same school boards.

The input has no filter. The output has no exit.

Connected analyses:
  • 🔬 Anderson Localization — judicial lattice disorder traps cases (companion analysis)
  • 🧬 Staff Data Braid — eight independent searches, convergent staff graph
  • 🧬 GLLG Data Braid — first Crump dynasty signal (Jehan + Verkeydia)
  • 📋 Credential Gap — MOECS audit of MacDowell staff
  • 🏛️ Institutional Capture — how the board was captured
  • 🔗 Enforcement Ecosystem — statewide enforcement gap

All measurements are derived from public records: school websites, LinkedIn profiles, MOECS public search, LARA entity records, ProPublica 990 filings, and court records. Problems originate in dynasties, move through entities, and land on humans. The humans are children. Verify everything.
